overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed messages would always be single-line like the example '/pulse feedback Dark mode please', but did not handle multi-line messages where the feedback text contains newlines.
why_it_breaks: The parsing logic likely expects '/pulse feedback' followed by text on the same line, but the actual message was '/pulse feedback Export is slow\nIt takes 2 minutes for 10k rows' with a newline. The parser probably only extracted the first line or failed to match the pattern entirely, causing no feedback item to be created despite the event being acknowledged.
